midnight-wine.$description: Midnight Wine — Primary action buttons, announcement banner, footer — a warm near-black maroon that reads as ink rather than red, anchoring the palette without screaming

royal-violet.$description: Royal Violet — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Secondary surface fills, light-tinted badges, ghost button backgrounds — desaturated violet that hints at the brand accent without claiming focus

deep-lagoon.$description: Deep Lagoon — Dark band section background for feature storytelling — the only dark surface in the system, paired with overlaid geometric art

warm-parchment.$description: Warm Parchment — Page canvas — the dominant surface; warm cream that replaces white as the base, giving the whole system an editorial warmth

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Hairline borders, card outlines, divider lines — warm light gray that disappears against parchment but defines edges crisply

ink-charcoal.$description: Ink Charcoal — Primary text, headings, icon strokes — warm near-black with just enough brown to feel like ink on paper, never a cold #000

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Secondary body text, helper copy, muted descriptions — the only mid-gray, used sparingly so it never competes with primary text

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Elevated card surfaces, floating UI overlays, text on dark backgrounds — reserved for cards that must lift off the parchment canvas

super-sans-vf.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system. Variable axes span 460 (the signature light-cut voice for all large display text) through 540 (body emphasis) to 700 (small bold labels). The custom VF is what makes weight 460 headlines feel intentional rather than accidental — at 48-64px with tight tracking the light cut reads as confidence, not thinness.
